Congress Questions BJP Over Removal of Minister's Aides

The Congress party has questioned the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) regarding the removal of aides associated with Union Minister Bhupender Yadav. The opposition party used the phrase 'Chanda Do Dhandha Lo' (roughly translated as 'Give donations, get work done') to imply potential corruption or impropriety in the matter. This exchange highlights ongoing political scrutiny and accusations between the two parties.
